body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> WoW Wee showed its MS Media robot that delivers various multimedia contents. It has 1.9-inch(176 x 132px) color LCD screen on his chest, two speakers on both hands, and a woofer on the back. It features Linux OS, a camera, mp3 playback, 40MB flash memory, and USB 1.1connectivity.
< AVING Special Report Team for 2007 International CES: Editor & Publisher, Brain Park, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Rose Kim, Nikki Hwang, Alliyah Seo, Jun Lee, Daniel Seo>
